title: 燧石岭销售例外模式
instruction:
您是 Olamide Donnelly，Flintridge Consortium 的销售经理，Bellhaven Clinic 在 140 地点推出的宠物和水生用品即将进入12 周商品审核。 Elena Bassett 需要在周一获得可靠的视图，了解哪些自有品牌 SKU 商店组合需要降价支持，哪些支持第二次重新订购，哪些明显变化只是小批量或不完整的货架周期噪音。不提供 EDI 852 记录的前八周，因为阈值必须前瞻性固定，而不是适应早期分布。使用`Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx`，其中包含批准的商店和 SKU 主数据、货架设置日期、所需的 EDI 字段、控制定义、允许的阈值范围、状态词汇和工作簿约定。将`Bellhaven_sell_through_exception_model.xlsx`构建为可重复使用的空白分析仪器。填充批准的主数据并做出 12 周审核所需的有界阈值决策，记录您的理由和试点设置的授权更改，但将所有每周 EDI 观察行和人工审核注释字段留空。每个星期一我应该能够粘贴新的每周记录并进行报告周、准备测试、期间比较、分类、SKU 汇总和例外列表更新，而无需单独重新键入派生值。
该模型需要区分不完整的历史和薄弱的基础与真正的恶化，保留计算的精确值，并仍然为埃琳娜提供材料变化及其可能驱动因素的直观清晰的视图。保持假设可见，准确使用批准的标签，防止可避免的输入错误，并使输入内容与计算内容一目了然。 Elena 在屏幕上查看模型，但打印会议的摘要和例外登记册，因此这些视图必须干净地打印一页宽，当登记册运行到其他页面时，具有可用的重复标题。请勿包含示例 EDI 交易、捏造的例外情况或预先写好的审阅者结论。将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层，使用文件名`Bellhaven_sell_through_exception_model.xlsx`。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx` — 提供批准的商店和 SKU 主数据、货架设置日期、所需的 EDI 输入字段、工作簿约定、控制定义、允许的参数范围、试点设置以及确切的状态、操作和原因代码词汇。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `Bellhaven_sell_through_exception_model.xlsx` — 可重复使用的空白销售例外工作簿，包含受管理的主数据、前瞻性选择的控制、公式驱动的期间分析、例外和摘要视图以及可打印的审核输出。 （将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。保留批准的主数据和选定的控制设置，但将每周 EDI 观察字段和人工审核注释字段留空。计算字段和输出必须保留实时公式而不是粘贴值。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

rows: Flintridge Consortium | governed blank instrument | Model version 1.0 | Governance source: Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx (Version 2026.08, effective 2026-08-25)
Paste one Sunday-ending EDI 852 row per Store ID + SKU + Week Ending into the blue input columns on Weekly Input. Do not overwrite formula columns, master data, or parameter cells.
Use the drop-downs and validation prompts. Correct duplicate-key highlights before relying on review outputs. Blank rows are intentional in this reusable instrument.
Review Parameters for the active, prospectively selected controls and the derived Reporting As-of Week. Never type an as-of date: it is the maximum valid Week Ending in Weekly Input.

criteria.description: 所需的 XLSX 存在于确切的顶级文件名中，并作为有效工作簿打开，没有修复警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 XLSX 解析器和 Office 应用程序（如果有）打开提交的文件；确认包有效且文件名准确。

original.criterion: The required XLSX exists at the exact top-level filename and opens as a valid workbook without repair warnings.
original.grader_hint: Open the submitted file with an XLSX parser and, if available, an office application; confirm the package is valid and the filename is exact.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含所需的确切工作表集以及所提供的工作簿约定指定的顺序。
criteria.grader_hint: 将工作表名称和 Tab 键顺序与 Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx 的工作簿约定部分进行比较。

original.criterion: The workbook contains the exact required worksheet set and order specified by the supplied workbook conventions.
original.grader_hint: Compare worksheet names and tab order against the workbook-conventions section of Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx.

criteria.description: 开场说明告诉不熟悉的星期一操作员要更新什么、不要覆盖什么、如何刷新评论以及如何解释每个结果，而无需进行口头培训。
criteria.grader_hint: 以仅拥有工作簿和提供的治理文件的操作员身份查看说明。他们应该区分输入、控制、计算输出、刷新顺序和结果含义。

original.criterion: The opening instructions tell an unfamiliar Monday operator what to update, what not to overwrite, how to refresh the review, and how to interpret each outcome without requiring oral training.
original.grader_hint: Review the instructions as an operator who has only the workbook and supplied governance file. They should distinguish inputs, controls, calculated outputs, refresh sequence, and outcome meanings.

criteria.description: 该工作簿清楚地标识了所提供的治理源及其版本或生效日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找确切的治理文件名或文档标题以及匹配的源版本/生效日期。

original.criterion: The workbook visibly identifies the supplied governance source and its version or effective date.
original.grader_hint: Look for the exact governance filename or document title and the matching source version/effective date.

criteria.description: 每周 EDI 输入表完全使用治理源中的必需字段名称，没有省略或重命名任何必需字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 将表标题作为一个集合与提供的工作簿中所需的 EDI 字段列表进行比较。

original.criterion: The weekly EDI input table uses exactly the required field names from the governance source, with no required field omitted or renamed.
original.grader_hint: Compare the table headers as a set against the required EDI field list in the supplied workbook.

criteria.description: 所有用户输入的每周 EDI 观察单元格均为空白：它们不包含示例文本、日期、数字或公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查指定为 EDI 输入的列中的每个现有数据行。标题、验证、格式和计算列不计为观察值。

original.criterion: All user-entered weekly EDI observation cells are blank: they contain no sample text, dates, numbers, or formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect every existing data row in columns designated as EDI inputs. Header, validation, formatting, and calculated columns do not count as observations.

criteria.description: 每周输入区域是一个实际的 Excel 表格，其范围、筛选器和计算列行为可以随着记录的粘贴而扩展。
criteria.evidence: 每周输入工作表表对象
criteria.grader_hint: 检查表定义、自动筛选状态、引用和计算列，而不是仅依赖可视格式。

original.grader_hint: Inspect table definitions, autofilter state, references, and calculated columns rather than relying on visual formatting alone.

original.criterion: A duplicate Store ID–SKU–Week Ending record is visibly detected before it can silently affect period calculations.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the formula or conditional-formatting rule used to detect the governed business-key duplicate. It must apply to future input rows.

criteria.description: 工作簿的商店主数据完全包含来自所提供源的不同的批准商店标识符，没有丢失或发明的商店。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿商店主数据与提供的商店名册
criteria.grader_hint: 比较提交的工作簿和 Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx 之间的标准化不同商店 ID 集。

original.criterion: The workbook's store master contains exactly the distinct approved store identifiers from the supplied source, with no missing or invented stores.
original.evidence: Workbook store master versus supplied Store Roster
original.grader_hint: Compare normalized distinct Store ID sets between the submitted workbook and Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx.

criteria.description: 工作簿的 SKU 主数据完全包含来自所提供来源的已批准的 SKU 标识符和受管属性。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿 SKU 主数据与提供的 SKU 主数据
criteria.grader_hint: 加入 SKU 并比较标识为受管理主字段的所有属性。

original.criterion: The workbook's SKU master contains exactly the approved SKU identifiers and governed attributes from the supplied source.
original.evidence: Workbook SKU master versus supplied SKU Master
original.grader_hint: Join on SKU and compare all attributes identified as governed master fields.

criteria.description: 模型中每个商店的货架设置日期等于其提供的主数据日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过商店 ID 连接提交和提供的商店主数据，并在标准化 Excel 日期存储后准确比较日期。

original.criterion: Each store's shelf-set date in the model equals its supplied master-data date.
original.grader_hint: Join submitted and supplied store masters by Store ID and compare dates exactly after normalizing Excel date storage.

criteria.description: 每个有界决策参数在其允许的治理范围内都有一个选定的数值，且所需的单位和方向明确。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源中标识为有限管理选择的每个参数。确认所选值位于其范围内且不留空。

original.criterion: Every bounded decision parameter has one selected numeric value within its permitted governance range, with the required unit and direction unambiguous.
original.grader_hint: Check each parameter identified as a bounded management choice in the source. Confirm the chosen value lies inclusively within its range and is not left blank.

criteria.description: 所有选定的阈值和截至本周的报告都通过公式使用的有效工作簿级别定义名称公开。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿定义的名称和公式引用
criteria.grader_hint: 检查定义的名称、它们的目的地和公式依赖性。名称不得解析为错误或不相关的单元格。

original.criterion: All selected thresholds and the reporting as-of week are exposed through valid workbook-level defined names used by formulas.
original.evidence: Workbook defined names and formula references
original.grader_hint: Inspect defined names, their destinations, and formula dependencies. Names must not resolve to errors or unrelated cells.

criteria.description: 参数基本原理简洁、具有前瞻性且站得住脚：它解决了不成熟的货架周期、低音量噪音、商店之间的常见移动以及未来漂移，而无需声称已安装不可用的 EDI 观测结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估基本原理是否解释了操作方面的有限选择并承认中心权衡，而不是仅仅重述参数值。

original.criterion: The parameter rationale is concise, prospective, and defensible: it addresses immature shelf cycles, low-volume noise, common movement across stores, and future drift without claiming to have fitted unavailable EDI observations.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the rationale explains the bounded choices in operational terms and acknowledges the central trade-off, rather than merely restating parameter values.

criteria.description: 控制更改记录将受管理的试点设置显示为先前值，将所选设置显示为新值，并包括授权所有者、有效周和原因。
criteria.evidence: 更改日志工作表或受管理的更改日志表
criteria.grader_hint: 将旧值与源导频设置进行比较，将新值与活动参数单元进行比较；验证是否使用请求中指定的授权人员填充了所需的元数据。

original.criterion: The control change record shows the governed pilot settings as the prior values, the selected settings as the new values, and includes the authorized owner, effective week, and reason.
original.evidence: Change Log worksheet or governed change-log table
original.grader_hint: Compare old values with source pilot settings and new values with active parameter cells; verify the required metadata is populated using the authorized person named in the request.

criteria.description: 每周报告是根据可用的每周输入而不是独立输入的重复日期得出的公式，并且当不存在观察时它保持空白。
criteria.evidence: 命名为本周单元格和先例图
criteria.grader_hint: 检查单元格公式。它应该引用每周输入的周末字段，在空白工具中不返回误导性的日期，并且不包含硬编码的报告日期。

original.criterion: The reporting as-of week is a formula derived from available weekly input rather than an independently typed duplicate date, and it remains blank when no observations exist.
original.evidence: Named as-of-week cell and precedent graph
original.grader_hint: Inspect the cell formula. It should reference the weekly input week-ending field, return no misleading date in the blank instrument, and not contain a hard-coded reporting date.

criteria.description: SKU-商店组合密钥是根据受管理的商店 ID 和 SKU 字段通过公式得出的，而不是单独输入的。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查键列的公式和先例。确认空白源行不产生可见键。

original.criterion: The SKU-store combination key is formula-derived from the governed Store ID and SKU fields rather than independently entered.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas and precedents for the key column. Confirm blank source rows produce no visible key.

criteria.description: 该模型通过公式从批准的店主那里获取货架设置日期，并且不需要将其输入到每个每周记录中。
criteria.evidence: 计算的货架设置日期字段
criteria.grader_hint: 检查查找公式并验证其查找源是受管理的存储主服务器。

original.criterion: The model obtains shelf-set date from the approved store master by formula and does not require it to be typed into each weekly record.
original.grader_hint: Inspect lookup formulas and verify their lookup source is the governed store master.

criteria.description: 保质周期年龄等于保质设定日期和相关周结束之间经过的时间，根据提供的惯例表示。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式并测试代表性注入日期，包括全周期边界之前的日期和正好位于全周期边界的日期。

original.criterion: Shelf-cycle age equals elapsed time between shelf-set date and the relevant week ending, expressed according to the supplied convention.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the formula and test representative injected dates, including dates before and exactly at the full-cycle boundary.

criteria.description: 仅当满足治理的所有货架周期、历史记录和库存充足性要求时，准备就绪和资格才成立。
criteria.evidence: 资格公式和注入边界情况
criteria.grader_hint: 评估紧邻每个受控边界下方、上方和上方的情况。任何一个通过的测试都不能覆盖失败的先决条件。

original.criterion: Readiness and eligibility are true only when all shelf-cycle, history, and in-stock sufficiency requirements from governance are met.
original.evidence: Eligibility formula and injected boundary cases
original.grader_hint: Evaluate cases immediately below, at, and above each governed boundary. No single passed test may override a failed prerequisite.

criteria.description: 使用治理公式根据已售数量和库存天数对每周速度进行标准化，因此部分可用性不会被视为完整的销售周。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪公式并注入具有部分库存天数的非零单位。将结果与提供的标准化规则在每标准化周 ±0.000001 单位内进行比较。

original.criterion: Weekly velocity is normalized from units sold and in-stock days using the governance formula, so partial availability is not treated as a full selling week.
original.grader_hint: Trace the formula and inject nonzero units with partial in-stock days. Compare the result with the supplied normalization rule within ±0.000001 units per normalized week.

criteria.description: 最近一周指标仅标识其周结束等于公式得出的截至周的记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 注入至少两周的结尾，并验证仅最长的受控周被标记为最新。

original.criterion: The latest-week indicator identifies only records whose week ending equals the formula-derived as-of week.
original.grader_hint: Inject at least two week endings and verify only the maximum governed week is marked latest.

criteria.description: 最近周期速度等于同一 SKU-商店组合的最近窗口中合格标准化观察值的受控聚合。
criteria.grader_hint: 注入一个小型的多周数据集并独立聚合满足组合、资格和最近窗口谓词的行；比较±0.000001范围内。

original.criterion: Recent-period velocity equals the governed aggregation of eligible normalized observations in the recent window for the same SKU-store combination.
original.grader_hint: Inject a small multiweek dataset and independently aggregate rows meeting combination, eligibility, and recent-window predicates; compare within ±0.000001.

criteria.description: 前期速度等于同一 SKU 商店组合的前一个比较窗口中合格标准化观察值的受控聚合。
criteria.grader_hint: 注入跨越两个窗口的观察结果，并将工作簿结果与 ±0.000001 内的独立受控聚合进行比较。

original.criterion: Prior-period velocity equals the governed aggregation of eligible normalized observations in the immediately preceding comparison window for the same SKU-store combination.
original.grader_hint: Inject observations spanning both windows and compare the workbook result with an independent governed aggregation within ±0.000001.

criteria.description: 本期变化是根据未四舍五入的最近和先前速度与受控符号约定来计算的。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪先例并测试积极和消极的变化。比较底层十进制表示的 ±0.000001 个百分点。

original.criterion: Own-period change is calculated from the unrounded recent and prior velocities with the governed sign convention.
original.grader_hint: Trace precedents and test positive and negative changes. Compare within ±0.000001 percentage points in underlying decimal representation.

criteria.description: 同期 SKU 同行基准仅使用同一 SKU 和最近一段时间的合格比较商店，并遵循所提供的基准统计数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 为一个SKU注入符合条件和不符合条件的店铺，并独立计算治理统计；不合格的观察不得影响它。

original.criterion: The contemporaneous SKU peer benchmark uses only eligible comparison stores for the same SKU and recent period, following the supplied benchmark statistic.
original.grader_hint: Inject eligible and ineligible stores for one SKU and independently calculate the governed statistic; ineligible observations must not influence it.

criteria.description: 同行差距使用受控符号约定将每个组合的最近速度与其同期 SKU 同行基准进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试高于同行统计数据的一种组合和低于同行统计数据的一种组合；比较±0.000001范围内的未四舍五入结果。

original.criterion: Peer gap compares each combination's recent velocity with its contemporaneous SKU peer benchmark using the governed sign convention.
original.grader_hint: Test one combination above and one below the peer statistic; compare the unrounded result within ±0.000001.

criteria.description: 低基数或噪声门使用选定的控制值，并防止弱量观察被提升为实质性降价或重新排序结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 在所选噪声边界的正下方和处注入其他合格记录，并验证受控边界行为。

original.criterion: The low-base or noise gate uses the selected control value and prevents weak-volume observations from being promoted to a substantive markdown or reorder outcome.
original.grader_hint: Inject otherwise qualifying records immediately below and at the chosen noise boundary and verify the governed boundary behavior.

criteria.description: 结果分类准确地实现每个批准的状态，并仅在其受控谓词下分配降价审查、重新排序候选、监控、噪音和未就绪结果。
criteria.evidence: 结果公式和批准状态列表
criteria.grader_hint: 对每个结果使用边界测试用例，并将发出的文本与批准的词汇进行精确比较。检查完整的谓词，而不仅仅是一个阈值。

original.criterion: Outcome classification implements every approved status exactly and assigns markdown review, reorder candidate, monitoring, noise, and not-ready outcomes only under their governed predicates.
original.evidence: Outcome formula and approved status list
original.grader_hint: Use boundary test cases for each outcome and compare emitted text exactly with the approved vocabulary. Check the full predicate, not only one threshold.

criteria.description: 当可以应用多个条件时，原因代码遵循提供的优先级，因此首先报告最基本的数据/准备情况限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 注入重叠的故障条件并验证在每个优先级选择的确切受控代码。

original.criterion: Reason codes follow the supplied precedence when more than one condition could apply, so the most fundamental data/readiness limitation is reported first.
original.grader_hint: Inject overlapping failure conditions and verify the exact governed code selected at each precedence level.

criteria.description: 分类、重要性和周期公式引用活动的命名参数单元格，而不是在公式中嵌入选定的阈值常量。
criteria.evidence: 公式标记和定义的名称
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式中对受控名称或参数单元格的引用。更改副本中选定的参数并确认相关逻辑更改，无需编辑公式。

original.criterion: Classification, materiality, and period formulas reference the active named parameter cells rather than embedding selected threshold constants in formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas for references to governed names or parameter cells. Change a selected parameter in a copy and confirm dependent logic changes without formula editing.

criteria.description: 空白行、零分母、缺少比较和不可用的对等组会返回有意的空白或受管理状态，而不是 Excel 错误。
criteria.evidence: 空白和边缘情况输入下的工作簿重新计算
criteria.grader_hint: 注入边缘情况并重新计算。搜索可见计算区域中的 #DIV/0!、#N/A、#VALUE!、#REF! 和误导性的零结果。

original.criterion: Blank rows, zero denominators, missing comparisons, and unavailable peer groups return intentional blanks or governed statuses rather than Excel errors.
original.evidence: Workbook recalculation under blank and edge-case inputs
original.grader_hint: Inject edge cases and recalculate. Search visible calculated areas for #DIV/0!, #N/A, #VALUE!, #REF!, and misleading zero results.

criteria.description: 基础汇率、变化、同行差距和排名指标保留完整的公式精度，并且在计算公式内不会四舍五入。
criteria.grader_hint: 在分类、排名或总计之前检查公式是否存在 ROUND 或等效精度损失。显示格式可能会在视觉上呈圆形。

original.criterion: Underlying rates, changes, peer gaps, and ranking metrics retain full formula precision and are not rounded inside calculation formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas for ROUND or equivalent precision loss before classifications, rankings, or totals. Display formatting may round visually.

criteria.description: 面向用户的比率和百分比使用简洁、一致的显示格式，同时保留其不四舍五入的数值。
criteria.evidence: 模型、例外和审核摘要的数字格式
criteria.grader_hint: 检查数字格式和基础值。验证精度是通过格式设置而不是文本转换或公式舍入来直观控制的。

original.criterion: User-facing rates and percentages use concise, consistent display formats while preserving their unrounded numeric values.
original.evidence: Number formats on Model, Exceptions, and Review Summary
original.grader_hint: Inspect number formats and underlying values. Verify that precision is visually controlled by formatting rather than text conversion or formula rounding.

criteria.description: 条件格式使实质性降价和重新排序结果易于区分，而不会掩盖噪音和未就绪状态，并且其规则引用实时值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查规则公式、范围、优先级和样式。确认调色板保持清晰，并且规则扩展到未来的输出行。

original.criterion: Conditional formatting makes substantive markdown and reorder outcomes readily distinguishable without obscuring noise and not-ready states, and its rules reference live values.
original.grader_hint: Inspect rule formulas, ranges, priorities, and styles. Confirm the palette remains legible and that rules extend across future output rows.

criteria.description: 异常寄存器由计算结果的公式或表逻辑填充，而不是手动维护的分类的第二个副本。
criteria.evidence: 例外工作表公式和先例
criteria.grader_hint: 将寄存器单元跟踪到模型/输入表并确认没有独立类型的异常记录。

original.criterion: The exception register is populated by formulas or table logic from calculated outcomes and is not a manually maintained second copy of the classifications.
original.grader_hint: Trace register cells to the model/input tables and confirm there are no independently typed exception records.

criteria.description: 刷新后，异常寄存器最多包含每个不同 SKU 存储组合的一个当前行，并排除非最新历史行。
criteria.evidence: 注入多周数据下的异常寄存器输出
criteria.grader_hint: 跨周注入重复的组合，重新计算，并将寄存器密钥集与满足受控异常谓词的不同的最近一周的组合进行比较。

original.criterion: After refresh, the exception register contains at most one current row per distinct SKU-store combination and excludes non-latest historical rows.
original.evidence: Exception-register output under injected multiweek data
original.grader_hint: Inject repeated combinations across weeks, recalculate, and compare the register key set with distinct latest-week combinations meeting the governed exception predicate.

criteria.description: 例外登记册公开了所提供的约定所需的所有审查字段，包括标识符、准备情况证据、最近和先前的措施、同行比较、结果、原因和行动。
criteria.evidence: 例外工作表标题和公式
criteria.grader_hint: 将可见寄存器字段与源中所需的异常视图字段列表进行比较，并确认计算字段包含公式。

original.criterion: The exception register exposes all review fields required by the supplied convention, including identifiers, readiness evidence, recent and prior measures, peer comparison, outcome, reason, and action.
original.grader_hint: Compare the visible register fields with the required exception-view field list in the source and confirm calculated fields contain formulas.

criteria.description: 异常行按受控操作优先级排序，然后按未舍入的严重性度量进行排序，并进行确定性平局处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 注入混合结果和圆形显示。确认排序遵循源优先级和全精度严重性，而不是可见的圆角文本。

original.criterion: Exception rows are ordered by the governed action priority and then by an unrounded severity measure, with deterministic tie handling.
original.grader_hint: Inject mixed outcomes and tied rounded displays. Confirm ordering follows the source priority and full-precision severity rather than visible rounded text.

criteria.description: 对于每个 SKU，审核摘要使用受控聚合基础从详细模型计算最近和之前的合格速度。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个 SKU 注入多个商店，并独立汇总两个期间符合条件的详细结果；比较±0.000001范围内。

original.criterion: For each SKU, the review summary calculates recent and prior eligible velocity from the detailed model using the governed aggregation basis.
original.grader_hint: Inject multiple stores per SKU and independently aggregate eligible detailed results for both periods; compare within ±0.000001.

criteria.description: 每个 SKU 的汇总方差等于其未四舍五入的最近测量值减去或根据提供的约定与其先前测量值进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪总结先例，并将计算出的绝对和百分比方差与 ±0.000001 范围内的独立计算进行比较。

original.criterion: Each SKU's summary variance equals its unrounded recent measure minus or compares with its prior measure according to the supplied convention.
original.grader_hint: Trace summary precedents and compare calculated absolute and percentage variances with independent calculations within ±0.000001.

criteria.description: 每个 SKU 的降价、重新订购、噪音、监控和未就绪组合的计数等于模型中携带这些结果的最近一周的不同组合计数。
criteria.evidence: 审核摘要结果计数与模型
criteria.grader_hint: 按 SKU 和结果对最新一周的不同型号密钥进行分组，并比较每个汇总计数；历史重复的内容不得重述。

original.criterion: Per-SKU counts of markdown, reorder, noise, monitoring, and not-ready combinations equal the distinct latest-week combination counts carrying those outcomes in the model.
original.evidence: Review Summary outcome counts versus Model
original.grader_hint: Group distinct latest-week model keys by SKU and outcome and compare every summary count; historical duplicates must not be recounted.

criteria.description: 摘要的建议操作桶源自批准的结果到操作映射，而不是独立键入。
criteria.evidence: 总结行动公式和治理映射
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪操作公式或查找，并将每个发出的操作与其结果的源映射进行比较。

original.criterion: The summary's recommended-action buckets are derived from the approved outcome-to-action mapping rather than typed independently.
original.evidence: Summary action formulas and governance mapping
original.grader_hint: Trace action formulas or lookups and compare every emitted action with the source mapping for its outcome.

criteria.description: 仅当满足所选重要性谓词并使用受控驱动程序逻辑和词汇时，才会生成材料更改标志和驱动程序解释。
criteria.evidence: 审查摘要重要性和驱动因素领域
criteria.grader_hint: 通过广泛而集中的商店模式注入非物质和物质SKU变化。验证阈值使用、驱动程序选择和确切批准的措辞。

original.criterion: Material-change flags and driver explanations are generated only when the selected materiality predicate is met and use the governed driver logic and vocabulary.
original.evidence: Review Summary materiality and driver fields
original.grader_hint: Inject immaterial and material SKU changes with broad and concentrated store patterns. Verify threshold use, driver selection, and exact approved wording.

criteria.description: 总计和总体结果计数与符合条件的详细人群和 SKU 摘要行的总和一致，不会重复计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立汇总注入的详细记录并比较总数和计数。还要验证 SKU 行总和与显示的总计在 ±0.000001 范围内进行测量并准确计算计数。

original.criterion: Grand totals and overall outcome counts reconcile to the eligible detailed population and the sum of SKU summary rows without double counting.
original.grader_hint: Independently aggregate injected detailed records and compare totals and counts. Also verify SKU rows sum to the displayed grand totals within ±0.000001 for measures and exactly for counts.

criteria.description: 审核摘要和例外工作表使用受管制的纸张尺寸和横向方向，恰好适合一页宽而不强制一页高，重复所需的标题，并包含指定的打印页脚。
criteria.evidence: 工作表页面设置、打印标题、打印区域和页眉/页脚
criteria.grader_hint: 检查页面设置对象。验证纸张尺寸、方向、fitToWidth=1、无约束或自动高度、重复标题行、受控页脚内容以及排除辅助区域的打印区域。

original.criterion: The Review Summary and Exceptions worksheets use the governed paper size and landscape orientation, fit to exactly one page wide without forcing one page tall, repeat required headings, and include the specified print footer.

spec.professional_context: A wholesale sales manager is preparing the governed analytical instrument that will support a single client launch review. The VP merchandising will use its Monday exception and summary views to separate genuine SKU-store underperformance from immature or noisy observations.
difficulty_sources: Selecting durable prospective thresholds within supplied governance ranges without fitting unavailable early sell-through data
Building a multi-stage formula graph that separates shelf-cycle readiness, history sufficiency, low-volume noise, own-period change, and contemporaneous peer performance
Keeping user-facing displays concise while preserving full numerical precision for classifications and ranking
Producing a blank reusable instrument whose summaries and exception register remain live, auditable, and printable

authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A compliant workbook contains governed master and configuration data but no weekly EDI observations or human review conclusions. Injecting conforming weekly records causes the complete dependent analysis and printable views to update without manual duplication.

control_policy: State the business purpose, review cadence, authorized decision owner, source version, and effective dates.
Supply the exact required workbook tab names and order, exact weekly input headers, exact exception and summary view fields, and print conventions.
Define the EDI business key as Store ID plus SKU plus Week Ending and specify the accepted week-ending weekday.
Define allowed values and bounds for units, net sales, receipts, on-hand quantity, and in-stock days.
Define full shelf-cycle readiness as elapsed time from the store shelf-set date to the observation week meeting the stated minimum.
Define eligible observations as records satisfying readiness, valid master-data membership, sufficient in-stock days, and all required history conditions.
Define normalized weekly velocity from units sold and in-stock days.
Define immediately adjacent recent and prior comparison windows and their inclusion boundaries.
Define the contemporaneous SKU peer statistic and require that only eligible stores contribute.
Provide bounded selection ranges for own-decline, peer-gap, low-base, reorder uplift, weeks-of-supply, and material-change controls. Include pilot settings separately from allowed ranges.
Define exact outcome labels, action labels, reason codes, reason precedence, action priority, and the mapping among them.
Define markdown review as the conjunction of readiness, sufficient history and base, own deterioration, and underperformance versus contemporaneous SKU peers.
Define reorder candidacy as the conjunction of readiness, sufficient history and base, governed positive performance tests, and the inventory-cover condition.
Define noise and not-ready outcomes so that they take precedence over substantive actions when prerequisites fail.
Define material SKU change using a selected threshold and define exact driver codes for broad SKU movement, store-concentrated movement, and residual or mixed movement.
Define the exact display formats, conditional-formatting semantic categories, paper size, orientation, repeated print headings, and footer content.

original_instruction:
You are Olamide Donnelly, the sales manager at Flintridge Consortium, and Bellhaven Clinic’s 140-location pet and aquatic supply launch is approaching its 12-week merchandising review. Elena Bassett needs a dependable Monday view of which private-label SKU-store combinations warrant markdown support, which support a second reorder, and which apparent changes are only low-volume or incomplete-shelf-cycle noise. The first eight weeks of EDI 852 records are not being supplied because the thresholds must be fixed prospectively rather than fitted to the early distribution. Use `Bellhaven_launch_governance.xlsx`, which contains the approved store and SKU masters, shelf-set dates, required EDI fields, control definitions, permitted threshold ranges, status vocabulary, and workbook conventions. Build `Bellhaven_sell_through_exception_model.xlsx` as a reusable blank analytical instrument. Populate the approved master data and make the bounded threshold decisions needed for the 12-week review, recording your rationale and the authorized change from the pilot settings, but leave all weekly EDI observation rows and human review-note fields empty. Each Monday I should be able to paste the new weekly records and have the reporting week, readiness tests, period comparisons, classifications, SKU rollups, and exception list update without separately re-keying derived values. The model needs to distinguish incomplete history and weak bases from genuine deterioration, preserve exact values for calculations, and still give Elena a visually clear view of material changes and their likely drivers. Keep assumptions visible, use the approved labels exactly, prevent avoidable input errors, and make it obvious what is entered versus calculated. Elena reviews the model on screen but prints the summary and exception register for the meeting, so those views must print cleanly one page wide, with usable repeated headings when the register runs onto additional pages. Do not include sample EDI transactions, fabricated exceptions, or prewritten reviewer conclusions. Write the finished file into the top level of the working directory, using exactly the filename `Bellhaven_sell_through_exception_model.xlsx`.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Bellhaven_sell_through_exception_model.xlsx` — Reusable blank sell-through exception workbook with governed master data, prospectively selected controls, formula-driven period analysis, exception and summary views, and printable review outputs. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory. Preserve approved master data and selected control settings, but leave weekly EDI observation fields and human review-note fields empty. Calculated fields and outputs must remain live formulas rather than pasted values.)
